seoDescription: Latest news and updates about Goertek products, technologies, and applications. As your authorized Goertek distributor, BeiLuo keeps you informed about the latest developments.

news.title: Goertek Expands MEMS Microphone Lineup with High-SNR Models
news.summary: Goertek introduces new high-performance MEMS microphones with improved SNR for voice assistant and professional audio applications.
news.content: Goertek has expanded its MEMS microphone portfolio with new high-SNR models designed for demanding voice recognition and professional audio applications. The new microphones feature up to 67dB SNR, providing exceptional audio clarity for far-field voice pickup and noise cancellation. These advanced microphones are ideal for smart speakers, voice assistants, and premium smartphones. As your authorized Goertek distributor, BeiLuo provides samples and technical support for these new products.

news.title: Goertek Achieves AEC-Q100 Grade 1 Qualification for Audio Components
news.summary: Goertek's automotive-grade MEMS microphones and speakers now qualified to AEC-Q100 Grade 1 standards for automotive applications.
news.content: Goertek announced that its automotive-grade MEMS microphones and micro speakers have AEC-Q100 Grade 1 qualification, meeting the stringent requirements for automotive applications. These components are qualified for operation from -40°C to +125°C, making them suitable for hands-free systems, voice recognition, and eCall applications in vehicles. Full PPAP Level 3 documentation is available. Contact BeiLuo for automotive component inquiries.

news.title: Goertek Launches Ultra-Low Power MEMS Sensors for Wearables
news.summary: New pressure sensors and accelerometers with sub-microamp power consumption enable year-long battery life in wearable devices.
news.content: Goertek has launched a new series of ultra-low power MEMS sensors specifically designed for wearable and IoT applications. The new pressure sensors consume only 2.7μA, while accelerometers use just 6.5μA in active mode and 0.5μA in sleep mode. These ultra-low power characteristics enable year-long battery life in fitness trackers and smartwatches. The sensors maintain high accuracy while minimizing power consumption. Contact BeiLuo FAE team for wearable sensor design support.

news.title: Goertek Expands Precision Manufacturing Capabilities
news.summary: New CNC machining and injection molding equipment enables tighter tolerances and faster turnaround for custom components.
news.content: Goertek has expanded its precision manufacturing capabilities with new CNC machining centers and injection molding equipment. The expansion enables tighter tolerances (±0.01mm for metal, ±0.05mm for plastic) and faster turnaround times for custom component orders. New capabilities include 5-axis CNC machining, micro-molding, and advanced surface finishing. These enhancements support growing demand for precision components in smartphones, automotive, and medical devices. Contact BeiLuo for custom manufacturing inquiries.

news.title: Goertek Introduces IPX7 Waterproof Micro Speaker Series
news.summary: New waterproof micro speakers enable audio in water-resistant smartphones, smartwatches, and outdoor devices.
news.content: Goertek has introduced a new series of IPX7 waterproof micro speakers designed for water-resistant electronic devices. The speakers feature special acoustic membranes that protect against water ingress while maintaining excellent sound quality. Available in multiple sizes (11x15mm to 16x20mm), these speakers enable audio in waterproof smartphones, smartwatches, and outdoor equipment. The IPX7 rating ensures protection during immersion up to 1 meter depth. Contact BeiLuo for waterproof speaker samples and integration guidance.
